title: ResumeDecisionPayload
description: Validation schema for human approval decisions resuming interrupted department branches.

department_id.description: Active fulfillment department branch being resumed.

decision.description: Operational review decision submitted by the department lead.

approver.description: Name of the authorized human approver (e.g. Ana Whitfield, Carlos Vega, Sofía Ramos).

feedback.description: Detailed revision feedback. Mandatory if decision is 'request_changes' or 'reject'.
